question: What does verse 89 state?
premises: this one would not hear what is spoken
inference: Because the matter is unpleasant, the hearer avoids what is spoken; though it is stated in Śrīmātaṅga, it is not studied out of fear of earthly consequences.
uncertainties: the exact referent of 'that' is unclear
plain_english: Because it is unpleasant, he will not hear what is spoken; in Śrīmātaṅga it is said, and it is not studied out of fear of the earth.
